messages:
elaine: quick thought  instead of the full-screen create modal, how about a compact right-side panel so people stay on the page? mock uploaded.

 tom: like that. main question: CTA should it be 'Create and reveal' or just 'Create'? people expect to see the secret immediately.

 maria: dev note  panel is straightforward. need explicit keyboard focus order: panel -> name -> reveal button -> copy. also allow skipping reveal.

 nick: a11y: when revealing the key use aria-live to announce 'API key revealed. Copy now; you will only see it once.' do not auto-select text for screen reader users. role=dialog + focus trap required.

 tom: microcopy suggestion: primary 'Create and reveal', secondary 'Create (hide secret)'. also update empty state copy to make single-view obvious. current empty state implies secrets are stored viewable which is wrong.

 elaine: proposed help text under name: 'This key is shown only once 1 — copy it now or store securely.' short and scannable.

 maria: backend detail: if reveal=false return a one-time download URL for 30s so users can fetch the secret file. API stub: POST /api-keys {name,reveal:false} -> {id, oneTimeDownloadUrl?}.

 nick: ensure download link has rel="noopener" and an accessible label; link should be focusable and announce expiry.

 tom: UX placement: prefer anchoring the copy/download UI inside the panel rather than a toast so keyboard users can find it reliably.

 elaine: also add a tiny info icon next to the one-time warning that opens a one-line explainer + docs link. keeps panel concise.

 maria: layout: panel width ~420px on desktop, fallback to full modal on narrow viewports. keyboard flow must still trap focus on mobile.

 nick: checklist for a11y: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby with single-view note, visible focus ring, announce "copied" via aria-live.

 elaine: empty state rewrite: 'No API keys yet 1 Create one to get started. Youll only see each key once.' primary CTA 'Create API key', small 'How keys work' link under.

 tom: for revoke: microcopy should suggest rotating if the key is used by critical routes: 'Prefer rotate to avoid downtime.' keep it muted.

 maria: rotate flow idea: built-in guided sequence: 1) create replacement, 2) switch usages, 3) revoke old. show a simple checklist and progress indicator.

 nick: ensure checklist items are keyboard reachable and announce progression. include a 'learn more' link.

 elaine: next steps: tom update Figma with panel + CTA variants, nick draft a11y checklist, maria prototype keyboard flow and the one-time download, i'll write final microcopy and run a 5-dev usability quick test.

 deploy-bot: figma file updated: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-panel  version: compact-panel-v1

 tom: i'll iterate copy tonight and post updated strings here. anyone want to pair on the usability script tomorrow?

 nick: morning works for me, happy to run a11y scenarios.

 maria: i'll mock the sandbox endpoint and share a curl sample for testing.

 elaine: great, i'll consolidate notes into the design doc and reach out to product-ops to schedule the test. :slightly_smiling_face:
